author: GoPro
description:
Take a ride through one of the most famous garden railroads on the internet! Located in Pasadena, California, Nicholas Johnson's @BungalowHeavenRailroad transforms the yard of his 100-year-old home into an incredible miniature world of model trains, detailed landscapes, and endless creativity.

This GoPro HERO13 Black POV puts you right on the tracks as you explore a backyard model train masterpiece filled with winding rails, tiny scenery, and the magic of a fully operating garden railroad.

What started as a passion project has grown into a miniature world inspiring model train fans, creators, and builders around the world.
